Leah (AE): Althea POC update — procurement says they need an HSM attestation and a DPA redline accepted before countersign. Order form has reserved capacity + 2x burst. Need sign path for HSM addendum. @Maya can you confirm e-sign options? Also pricing question: will we honor the committed capacity discount if they move to Dedicated after POC?

Maya (Sales Ops): We can route through DocuSign with the HSM addendum attached as Exhibit A. For special SSO/KMS clauses we usually require Legal ok. e-sign path: Sales -> Procurement -> Legal -> Finance. I can create envelope if Legal approves redline. :calendar:

Devon (Solutions Eng): Technical: HSM attestation is a 3rd-party cert we can provide (HSM vendor cert + Redwood attestation letter). However, Dedicated + HSM is a Private deployment feature — pricing differs. If they want Dedicated reserved GPU pool with HSM, need a 'Dedicated+HSM' sku. Sample snippet for order form line item:
```
Product: Redwood Dedicated (Reserved)
SKU: DED-HSM-1
Qty: 1
Term: 12mo
Committed QPS: 200
Burst: 2x
```
We can map to the committed discount tier.

Samir (Legal): Legal: Please send the DPA redline to me directly. We don't accept vendor HSM attestations alone; we need vendor SOC2 + HSM vendor cert and an internal attestation. Also need to confirm retention and subprocessors. If Althea insists on changing the MSA SLA language around data residency, escalate to Enterprise Legal. @Leah attach the customer's proposed redline.

Leah (AE): Uploading redline now: https://files.redwood/althea_DPA_redline_v3.pdf. Quick ask: can Sales Ops send the DocuSign envelope with both MSA+DPA+HSM addendum? Or do we want separate envelopes?

Maya (Sales Ops): Prefer single envelope to avoid multiple countersigns. But Finance wants PO before countersign if billing > $100k. I can set routing: procurement -> legal -> finance -> exec. If they need net30 vs net60, that's a billing hold.

Samir (Legal): Single envelope ok, but we must include signatory delegation check. For non-exec signatures we need PO + proof of authority. I'll review redline by EOD. If we need to carve out HSM clause, I'll propose an addendum clause.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created by Maya at 2025-03-12T14:05Z — Envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d. Current status: awaiting procurement signature.

Leah (AE): :thumbsup: Thanks team. Action items: @Samir review redline; @Maya prep envelope with Exhibit A HSM addendum attached and routing (procurement->legal->finance->exec); @Devon confirm SKU/pricing rec for Dedicated+HSM. I'll update Althea. Keeping thread open.
